sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet slots and 89 September 27–28 channel briefs screened.
Signed-in X conference feed and focused conference search reviewed; 283 public account candidates sampled, including subnet teams, partners, commentators and quoted accounts.
175 repository paths scanned; 15 selected changes read at patch level.
Signed-in AlphaGap leaderboard, SubnetRadar, TAO Daily, TAO Media and 53 linked Moments reviewed.
Seven previous editions checked for unresolved incidents, duplicates, upcoming events and identity changes. Full-roster market outliers and emission leaders reviewed.
YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked: no new upload or replacement stream found; October 1 SN49 Nepher appearance remains upcoming.
accessGaps: Research began at 2:10 PM ET and continued through 2:19 PM ET. Conference sessions after this cutoff remain unreported.
13 repository paths had access errors. 10 public account candidates returned no usable post links. Sampling is not exhaustive X coverage and no Grok scan is claimed.
Channel briefs are secondary, AI-generated summaries; team-attributed and community-only reports are distinguished. Releases alone do not prove live rewards or deployment.
SN35 and SN82 currently lack a verified project identity in the market feed. Historical returns may span identity changes; no new identity or holder migration is assumed.
SN94 Cathedral beta is based on a team-attributed channel brief; the old BitSota account is unavailable. No sandbox transaction, refund or subnet ownership transfer was performed.

decisions.reason: Current roster has no verified project name and only a legacy repository reference. No fresh supported project event was located; do not attribute the price decline to an invented cause.
Official Epago profile and repository reviewed without a fresh material announcement. The daily decline is not sufficient evidence of a new incident.
New primary live-product announcement and time-labelled price context; the weekly rise alone is not the catalyst or the basis for its rating.
Official account, project repository and recent report history reviewed. No new verified material event explains the drop; prior whitepaper and revenue routes are already covered.
Yesterday already covered Compelle deregistration and a new registration. Current identity remains unconfirmed; the cross-registration weekly return is not a fresh Compelle investment story.

editorialDecisions: Gamma is a design announcement, not live deployment. Five stars reflect ecosystem reach, not price or an instruction to buy.
SN96/SN106 consolidation is primary-confirmed; handover and token conversion are not claimed complete.
SN93 partner announcement confirmed; validator dates back to September 23 and is not a fresh launch. Second application name not asserted without primary confirmation.
SN9 pilots expected in October; benchmark and customer-conversation figures remain presentation claims.
SN64 talk is later today. No future presentation result or fresh 20B benchmark inferred.
SN91 Ephemeris and SN100 OpenType already covered September 25; exclude recycled launch briefs. SN91 governance-code changes are not used to amplify miner allegations.
SN120 code supersedes the channel discussion of a proposed 0.1 margin, which was covered yesterday. Cover today’s separate admission-probe correction.
SN68 drug-approval wording from a secondary conference post not published: approval type, indication, authority and original evidence need clarification.
SN72 NATIX/Valeo world-model post checked; no new dated partnership or deployment established beyond a recap.
SN85 competition results are community-only and payout not independently checked; live conference product is better supported.
SN31 mainnet and SN46 launch timing remain inconsistent relative-date channel plans, not completed launches. SN78 cohort restart and SN55 scoring investigation remain unconfirmed.
Market outliers SN35/SN36/SN49/SN82 explicitly excluded with rationale; SN38 covered. AlphaGap secondary movers and emission leaders cross-checked against current repositories and posts.
Emission leaders SN51/SN64/SN120/SN44/SN80 covered; SN4/SN107/SN3/SN8/SN9/SN53/SN15 reviewed. Routine trading promotions and unverified complaints excluded. SN9 has its own SDK story.
Moments window contains wallet commentary and SN94 price event, no newly selected verified ownership or lock event; do not infer wallet intent or causes.
Unrelated StonkFun/Cardano/CAKE launches and sports posts excluded. Account-candidate total is not a count of subnet team accounts.
Yesterday-only hourly automation deleted after expiry; this daily run does not renew it or post to X.
YouTube unchanged; removed/postponed streams remain excluded.
